title: observability: token-level KV cache metrics, tracing spans, dashboard and alert tuning
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Adds token-level KV cache metrics, corresponding tracing spans, a Datadog dashboard for token/KV cost & latency breakdowns, and tuned alerts to reduce noise. Motivation: recent incidents showed high token tail-latency correlated with low KV cache hit rates. This PR surfaces per-request token & KV metrics and end-to-end spans so owners can quickly triage performance regressions and correlate cost impact.

What changed (high level):
- Expose per-request token count, tokens_generated, kv_cache_hits, kv_cache_misses, kv_cache_evictions as metrics with cardinality limited via sampling and labels (model, region, route).
- Add tracing spans around KV cache lookup and cache population with duration tags to correlate with token latency.
- New Datadog dashboard (token-level cost & latency) and templated widgets for model/region/route breakdown.
- Alert tuning: moved from static thresholds to adaptive alerts (p90/p99 over 5m windows) and reduced pager noise by adding SLO-backed alerting and runbook links.
- Tests and integration: unit tests for metric tagging, end-to-end test exercising KV hit/miss path, dashboard validation JSON.

Checklist:
- [x] Metrics instrumented and unit-tested
- [x] Tracing spans added and covered by integration test
- [x] Dashboard JSON validated against Datadog schema
- [x] Alerts adjusted and runbook links added
- [x] Docs/console notes updated (observability changelog)

Notes on design decisions:
- To avoid high cardinality we sample high-volume routes by default and provide an opt-in flag for full cardinality for enterprise customers.
- Metric names follow the existing observability naming convention (redwood.*) and include model/route tags.
- Adaptive alerts use p90/p99 baselines computed over a 7d window; this reduces noisy pages during expected diurnal traffic patterns.

CI summary: initial integration job flaked on a synthetic KV eviction test; fixed by adding retry/backoff and a deterministic fixture. Final CI: all checks passed.

Related Linear/Jira: ENG-1123, ENG-1178, SUP-221.
